title: Beyond Private Training: The New Landscape of AI Privacy
abstract: arXiv:2609.19456v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented systems increasingly rely on vector indexes that may retain deleted items in their search graph. Existing deletion interfaces can prevent deleted identifiers from appearing in returned results while still computing distances to their embeddings during graph traversal. We formalize this distinction as output safety versus traversal safety, and introduce TSD-AUDIT, a framework for auditing and enforcing traversal-safe deletion in graph-based approximate nearest-neighbor retrieval. On Faiss IndexHNSWFlat, native filtering leaves the number of distance computations unchanged relative to unfiltered search; at a 70% deletion rate, trace-faithful replay detects deleted-vector scoring in all 100 audited queries. Code inspection of hnswlib's mark_deleted path reveals the same scoring-before-liveness pattern. TSD-AUDIT enforces an alive-before-scoring invariant, repairs connectivity using only live candidates, and emits per-q

translated_title: 超越私有训练：AI隐私的新格局
translated_abstract: 检索增强系统日益依赖向量索引，而这些索引可能在搜索图中保留已删除的条目。现有的删除接口能够防止已删除的标识符出现在返回结果中，但在图遍历过程中仍会对其嵌入向量进行距离计算。我们将这一区别形式化为“输出安全”与“遍历安全”，并提出了TSD-AUDIT——一个用于审计和强制实施基于图的近似最近邻检索中遍历安全删除的框架。在Faiss IndexHNSWFlat上的实验表明，原生过滤使距离计算次数相对于未过滤搜索完全没有减少；在70%的删除率下，基于轨迹忠实重放的检测在全部100个被审计查询中都发现了对已删除向量的评分行为。对hnswlib的mark_deleted路径的代码检查也揭示了同样的“先评分后活性检查”模式。TSD-AUDIT强制执行“先活性检查后评分”的不变量，仅使用活跃候选修复图连接性，并输出每个查询的审计信息。
tldr: 本文提出TSD-AUDIT框架，首次形式化了向量索引删除中“输出安全”与“遍历安全”的本质区别，并揭示了Faiss和hnswlib等主流系统在删除数据后仍会在图遍历中计算已删除向量距离这一被忽视的隐私风险，通过强制“先活性检查后评分”不变量实现真正安全的删除。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TSD-AUDIT, a framework that formalizes the distinction between output safety and traversal safety, reveals that mainstream systems like Faiss and hnswlib still compute distances to deleted vectors during graph traversal despite claiming deletion, and enforces a live-before-scoring invariant to guarantee genuinely traversal-safe deletion.
